description: Manage Focuses — the top-level buckets that group Life Projects. Every project lives inside one focus (or 'No Focus'). Use list to see all focuses + their project counts, create to add a new bucket (e.g. 'Astra', 'Atlas', 'Fundraising'), update/delete to maintain them. Pass the returned focus_id to mind_life when creating projects.

action.description: list/get/create/update/delete focuses. 'delete' soft-archives by default; pass hard=true to remove permanently.

agent_ids.description: Agents bound to every project inside this focus. On update, REPLACES the existing list.

color.description: Color stripe used in the UI

hard.description: On delete — true to remove permanently (default false = soft archive)

include_archived.description: On list — true to include archived focuses (default false)

workflow_ids.description: Workflows bound to every project inside this focus. On update, REPLACES the existing list.

name: mind_focuses
